steps.summary: Signed into Odoo 17 with admin/admin, navigated to Contacts, created a new contact named 'rpod4-r1 Bench Customer' with City set to 'Benchville', and saved it. The record was created (id=44) and the form displays the name as "rpod4-r1 Bench Customer" and the city as "Benchville", confirming both values were saved correctly.

Created a Quotation (S00021) for customer 'rpod4-r1 Bench Customer'. Added one order line: product **[E-COM07] Large Cabinet**, quantity 3. The app auto-filled **Unit Price = £320.00** (excl. tax), and computed **Untaxed Amount = £960.00** (3 × £320.00). The quotation is saved but not yet confirmed.

On Quotation S00021 (customer 'rpod4-r1 Bench Customer'), which already had line 1: [E-COM07] Large Cabinet qty 3 × £320.00 = £960.00, added a second order line via the Catalog: **[E-COM08] Storage Box**, quantity 2, unit price **£15.80**, line subtotal £31.60. The app computed the new **Untaxed Amount = £991.60** (£960.00 + £31.60). The quotation remains unconfirmed (status: Quotation).

On Quotation S00021 (customer 'rpod4-r1 Bench Customer'), changed the first line ([E-COM07] Large Cabinet) quantity from 3 to 5. Unit price stayed £320.00, so the new first line subtotal = **£1,600.00** (5 × £320.00). The second line ([E-COM08] Storage Box qty 2 × £15.80 = £31.60) unchanged. The app computed new **Untaxed Amount = £1,631.60** (£1,600.00 + £31.60). Quotation remains unconfirmed.
Confirmed Quotation S00021 (customer 'rpod4-r1 Bench Customer') into a Sales Order. The status bar now displays **"Sales Order"** as the active state. The order reference remains **S00021**.

Cancelled Sales Order S00021 (customer 'rpod4-r1 Bench Customer'). A confirmation dialog appeared and was accepted (action="Cancel"). The status bar now displays **"Cancelled"** as the active state. The order reference remains S00021.
